annotation.authors_or_issuer: Standing Senate Committee on Transport and Communications (Senate of Canada)
key_provisions_or_claims: Create a joint Transport Canada–ISED policy unit to coordinate a national AV/CV strategy
Transport Canada to urgently develop vehicle safety guidelines for automated and connected vehicles
Develop cybersecurity guidance and a real-time crisis network with CSE and Public Safety Canada
Empower the Privacy Commissioner to enforce PIPEDA proactively and assess connected-car privacy rules
Monitor insurance, infrastructure, competition and jobs impacts; strengthen retraining and R&D funding
named_instruments_referenced: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
annotation.summary_en: Canadian Senate committee report on automated and connected vehicles, based on 78 witnesses. It reviews benefits and challenges (safety, jobs, privacy, cybersecurity, infrastructure) and makes 16 recommendations for federal leadership, safety guidelines, cybersecurity, privacy enforcement, R&D, insurance monitoring and workforce retraining.
